title: fix(i18n,app-shell): the same-origin marketplace hint stops claiming the runtime serves the catalog (objectui#11726)
body:
Fixes #11726

Clause-②: no

## What changed

On a runtime whose config reports `cloudUrl: ''`, a catalog load that failed for a reachability reason drew "This runtime serves the marketplace catalog itself. Check that the runtime is online." `''` is the producer's "stay on this origin" spelling. The CLI's cloud-connected `os serve` reports it while its marketplace proxy forwards to `cloud.objectos.ai`, so on that runtime the sentence named the wrong server.

- **The hint.** `marketplace.load.failedHintSameOrigin` now says only that the catalog is reached through this runtime, plus the advice to check that the runtime is online and can reach the catalog. All ten packs change. In `en`: "The marketplace catalog is reached through this runtime. Check that the runtime is online and can reach the catalog." No key is added, removed or moved.
- **The contract's doc.** `runtime-config.ts`: the `AppShellRuntimeConfig.cloudUrl` and `getCloudBase` docblocks no longer say the runtime "*is* the cloud". `''` means requests stay on this origin, and the runtime may serve the catalog or proxy a control plane it does not name.
- **The page.** `MarketplacePage.tsx`: comments only, at the `cloudBase` read and on the hint branch. The rendering logic is unchanged.
- **Unchanged.** A runtime that reports its plane keeps `marketplace.load.failedHintConfigured`, which names it.

The hint stays true on each `''` runtime:

- a runtime that proxies a plane: the catalog is reached through it;
- the control plane serving its own catalog: the same;
- an air-gapped runtime (`features.marketplace: false`): it draws the disabled state and never this hint.

### Why "and can reach the catalog"

On the proxying runtime, every hint-showing failure except "no answer" is a `502` / `503` / `504` that the runtime itself answered, so "check that the runtime is online" alone points at a server that just replied. The added clause covers the hop behind it without naming the hop or claiming one exists.

## Naming the host: none, measured

The ruling allowed naming the upstream host where a failure carries it. No failure carries it in a structured place, so the hint names none and `failedHintConfigured` is not reused. Measured by bundling `MarketplaceProxyPlugin` from objectstack `803764a36f` (a ref fetched for this run; objectstack is not edited), driving its real handler with a stubbed upstream, and recording the response:

| case | status | headers | body |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| upstream fetch throws (DNS failure; its `cause` names `cloud.objectos.ai`) | 502 | `content-type: application/json` | `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"MARKETPLACE_PROXY_FAILED","message":"fetch failed"}}` |
| upstream answers 502 | 502 | upstream `content-type`, `x-cache: BYPASS` | upstream body, verbatim |
| upstream answers 503 | 503 | upstream `content-type`, `x-cache: BYPASS` | upstream body, verbatim |
| upstream answers 504, empty body | 504 | `content-type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8`, `x-cache: BYPASS` | empty |

The proxy drops the error's `cause`, adds no field naming the upstream, and forwards only `content-type` / `cache-control` / `etag` / `last-modified` / `vary` plus `x-cache`. A browser-side network failure has no response at all. The resolved plane under no `OS_CLOUD_URL` was `https://cloud.objectos.ai`. Reading a host out of the message would parse server prose as data, so nothing does. A new pin case puts a host in the server's message and asserts it stays in the cause line and never reaches the hint.

## Tests

All at head `4658b17` unless marked. That head is the merge of `main` `02a3896`, made after objectui#11731 landed in the same ten packs. `git diff 02a3896 HEAD` is exactly this change's 17 files.

- **The full suite.** `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/ packages/i18n/` at `1a1bdd3` (this change before the merge): `Test Files 1115 passed | 1 skipped (1116)`, `Tests 11511 passed | 22 skipped (11533)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **The narrowed run after the merge, declared.** `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/ packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/` at `4658b17`: `Test Files 116 passed (116)`, `Tests 1809 passed | 13 skipped (1822)`, exit 0. The merge brought only changes that had already been through CI.
- **The new pin.** `MarketplacePage.sameOriginHint-11726.test.tsx` passes all 12 cases:
  - 5 per language under `cloudUrl: ''`: the proxy's 502 envelope, a forwarded 503, an empty 504, no answer at all, and a host named in the server prose;
  - the configured plane, verbatim, in `en` and `zh`.
- **The build and type-checks.** `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' run build` exits 0. Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` both exit 0. Both run `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, and `--listFilesOnly` puts the three touched app-shell test files and the touched i18n test in those programs.
- **The published delta.** In the built `@object-ui/i18n` `locales/en.d.ts`, the one literal type of `failedHintSameOrigin` changes to the new sentence. No key is added or removed.
- **Lint, narrowed to the 16 touched `.ts` / `.tsx` files.** `eslint --format json` reports 16 files, 0 errors and 2 warnings. Both warnings are in `MarketplacePage.tsx` and both are present at the merge base: `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` on `void load()`, and `no-explicit-any` on `catch (e: any)`. The population is the config's `**/*.{ts,tsx}` block. Type-aware linting is not enabled (`tseslint.configs.recommended`, no `parserOptions.project`), and no custom rule reads another file, so this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.
- **Gates at `4658b17`, all exit 0:**
  - `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (1 `en` value changed, 9 packs followed), `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`;
  - `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`;
  - `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`;
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`;
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 17 paths: NOT GOVERNED.

## Ablation

Run from the committed tree, with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack) doing each mutation and its proven restore. The direction was predicted before each run.

- **Leg 1: the old value restored in `en` and `zh`.** Predicted: the 8 same-origin claim cases red on the "routes through this runtime" assertion; the 2 host-in-prose cases and the 2 configured-plane cases green. Observed: `Tests 8 failed | 4 passed (12)`, red on `expected 'This runtime serves the marketplace c…' to match /through this runtime/i` and `expected '本运行时自己提供应用市场目录。请检查运行时是否在线。' to match /通过本运行时/`. Restore: `en.ts` blob `2305b97065cb` == HEAD, `zh.ts` blob `94c6684df880` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, status clean.
- **Leg 2: `en` keeps "through this runtime" but adds "which serves it itself".** This proves the negative half can fail on its own. Predicted: the 4 `en` claim cases red on the no-serving-claim assertion, everything else green. Observed: `Tests 4 failed | 8 passed (12)`, red on `not to match /\bserves?\b|\bitself\b/i`. Restore: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

`@object-ui/i18n` resolves to `packages/i18n/src` through the root vitest alias, so no `dist` rebuild sat between mutation and measurement.

## Acceptance notes

- **Same reading, outside this card's surface, left untouched.** These sites gate install and sample-data behaviour, not this hint. Whether that behaviour is right on a proxying `''` runtime was not measured here.
  - `marketplaceApi.ts`: the `installPackage` docblock ("When the runtime *is* the cloud") and `cloudConsoleUrl()` ("`''` when this runtime has no upstream cloud").
  - `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`: the reseed/purge gate comment ("Only offer them when the runtime IS the cloud (same-origin)").

  Noted, not filed; no carrier.
- **The producer's docblock, objectstack side.** `RuntimeConfigPluginConfig.controlPlaneUrl` in `@objectstack/cloud-connection` says an explicit `''` declares "this runtime IS the cloud" (same-origin for marketplace + install). The same file's constructor comment, the package README and `Serve.RUNTIME_CONFIG_OPTIONS` all say "stay on this origin", and the CLI's cloud-connected arm passes `''` beside a mounted proxy. This is reported to the seat as an out-of-scope finding; it is not edited here.
- **No new runtime-config key**, per the ruling. Nothing measured here says the console needs to know that an upstream exists: the hint is true without knowing.
- **The `{{url}}` hint is unreachable on the CLI's cloud arm.** That arm reports `''`, so a host can appear in the hint only if the producer reports one. That is the ruling's ⛔ on a new key, kept as ruled.
- **NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-locale-catalogues`**, reason: it needs a built console bundle (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`). This diff changes no import, which is the composition that gate weighs. The byte budget (`performance-budget.yml`) is CI's.
- **`skip-changeset` is not used.** `.changeset/11726-marketplace-hint-same-origin.md` declares `@object-ui/i18n: patch`: a published pack value changes, and no key, export or prop moves. The app-shell files change only comments and tests.
